Substantial campaign cash reserves provide a tactical buffer to shift momentum before November.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing historical polling anomalies (WHAT) with current structural deficits (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
Campaigns often project optimism onto shaky data to maintain donor confidence and voter morale, substituting historical outlier trends for ground-level realities.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic optimism masks underlying vulnerabilities.

The Unavoidable Truth: Polling averages currently show the GOP trailing in eight critical Senate races.

The Unavoidable Lie: Historical polling errors guarantee that current deficits will entirely reverse.
